The latest Journal poll is not the only warning sign for Republicans. A state-by-state analysis published this month found Trump underwater in 41 states and every major battleground state. The analysis, based on Civiqs tracking data, showed only nine states still gave the president a positive net approval rating.

Some of the largest declines were recorded in Iowa, Ohio, Oklahoma, Tennessee and Texas.

The figures come from Civiqs’ continuing online tracker of 132,219 responses taken between January 20, 2025, and September 24, 2026, so they measure changing opinion rather than polling on specific contests.

Because white-voter figures in an individual state are subgroup estimates rather than stand-alone statewide polls, small differences should not be treated as precise forecasts.
